Every hypothesis, Hardy normalization, compactness boundary and infinite-versus-finite check is explicit. CHECK.py passed 107 finite corroborating assertions, not used as an infinite proof.

value.rationale: Recent SRKT research asks when reproducing-kernel testing detects full Hardy Hankel norm. The theorem identifies a natural complete family of all inner-function pullbacks of a strip-log symbol, proves sharp noncompactness despite interior attainment of the kernel supremum, and classifies the entire norming set B^{-1}((-1,1)). For monomial inner functions this yields arbitrarily many norming diameters, while the same exact gap persists for inner functions with infinite Blaschke or singular factors. The exact essential norm and geometry are qualitative structural information beyond routine normalized evaluations.
